San Sebastián & Bilbao (Donostia · Bilbao) — Guida di Viaggio Spagna: Cosa Vedere, Trasporti e Cucina

La Concha bay promenade, Parte Vieja pintxo bars, Michelin gastronomy and Bilbao's Guggenheim Museum.

RegioneBasque Country
Periodo MiglioreApr–Jun & Sep–Oct
Stay3–4 days

Panoramica

San Sebastián & Bilbao (Donostia · Bilbao) is one of the essential stops in Spain, located in the Basque Country region. La Concha bay promenade, Parte Vieja pintxo bars, Michelin gastronomy and Bilbao's Guggenheim Museum.

With direct connections via Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail, San Sebastián & Bilbao rewards a stay of 3–4 days so you can balance major landmarks with neighborhood cafés, markets, and easy half-day excursions.

  • San Sebastián & Bilbao Historic Center & Main Square: Signature highlight in San Sebastián & Bilbao — reserve morning entry tickets online in peak season.

Come Arrivare e Muoversi

San Sebastián & Bilbao is served by Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail and intercity express trains as well as regional airport transfers. Book high-speed legs 2–6 weeks ahead for early-bird fares.

The historic core of San Sebastián & Bilbao is best explored on foot, supplemented by contactless tap-to-pay metro, tram, or bus lines.

Dove Dormire

  • Budget: Well-connected hostels and guesthouses within a 10-minute walk of San Sebastián & Bilbao's central station or metro lines.
  • Mid-range: Boutique 3-to-4-star hotels near the historic center and pedestrian promenade.
  • Luxury: Heritage 5-star grand hotels and design properties with concierge access and views.
